scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/verify_release_config.mjs
scripts.tauri:dev:macos: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-macos npm run tauri dev -- --config src-tauri/tauri.macos.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:macos: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-macos npm run tauri build -- --config src-tauri/tauri.macos.conf.json --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app
scripts.tauri:dev:windows: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-windows npm run tauri dev -- --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:windows: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-windows npm run tauri build -- --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.tauri:build:macos:dmg: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-macos npm run tauri build -- --config src-tauri/tauri.macos.conf.json --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
